caption: The drawing depicts a tall, rectangular wooden cabinet standing on four small, dark round legs. The cabinet is rendered in shades of red-brown, with darker swirling wood grain patterns visible throughout its surface. The cabinet features a slightly protruding top ledge with rounded upper edges and three prominent horizontal sections separated by thin lines, with each section containing a keyhole in the center. The cabinet has a relatively plain façade, devoid of ornate decorations, with the grain of the wood providing the visual texture. Below the cabinet, the name “Joseph Cannella” is written in blue text, and a faint number appears to the right of the name. The background is an off-white or light cream color with no other objects or elements depicted.
